actionEvents.sourcePoseSemanticBathEventField: No per-pose splash/dip/feather event field found in inspected strict animationPoseSchema.

spriteContractBoundary.legacyActions: V3 clips include optional bathing; named action alone is not scene adoption.
spriteContractBoundary.shapeLandmarks: Separate shape schema can name beak/head/body/tail/feet; a named landmark is not an authorized water contact or action event.
spriteContractBoundary.commonFamilyV6: Requires neutral-only static idle and no contacts/activity clips. commonMotion blink/look cannot silently carry bathing.
spriteContractBoundary.worldAnchor: poseTransform uses reviewed shape support if present, otherwise pivot; world position is support anchor, not sprite top-left.
spriteContractBoundary.missingClip: Sampler may fall back to idle; does not prove bathing art or correct live binding.
